report.summary: Chunk 1 of scheduler.py: module docstring, imports, constants, helper function, two dataclasses, and KairosScheduler.__post_init__ and accept method signature.
risks: FREE_LANES | low | Defines lanes that are 'free' but deepseek and codex_cli may have costs not reflected here. | Check if deepseek and codex_cli truly have no cost or if comment is misleading.
_paths_overlap | low | Function is defined but not called in this chunk; may be dead code or used later. | Verify usage in subsequent chunks.

KairosScheduler.__post_init__ | medium | Imports inside method (load_project, load_policy) may cause late import errors or circular imports. | Confirm that those imports are safe and not causing runtime issues.

max_parallel_writes default | medium | Comment warns about unmeasured cost for N>1 but default is 2; risk of performance degradation. | Measure actual cost of concurrent writes and adjust default accordingly.
todos: Verify that _paths_overlap is actually used somewhere.
Check that imports inside __post_init__ do not cause circular imports.
Consider adding logging or metrics for concurrent write performance.

claims.text: Kairos never talks to the user, never decides trust, and bounces anything that belongs to the senior crew back to the trusted orchestration layer.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain the implementation of KairosScheduler methods that would show user interaction, trust decisions, or bouncing logic.

claims.text: Ikarus then: dynamically spawns local workers from a bounded pool, briefs each with a scoped task + the owning specialist's domain, enforces their *reduced rights*, returns a consolidated report for Adam / the owning specialist to review.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain the implementation of worker spawning, briefing, rights enforcement, or report consolidation.

claims.text: Free means free of CLAUDE tokens: ollama is truly free/local; deepseek and codex_cli are external and spend their own (cheap/subscription) budget.
claims.why: The chunk does not verify the cost model of deepseek or codex_cli; the comment is not backed by code in this chunk.

claims.text: This is not a proof of write isolation: an agent may touch an undeclared path. Production write concurrency therefore remains disabled until each task owns a separate Forge workcell/worktree.
claims.why: The function only checks declared paths and does not prevent undeclared writes; the comment accurately describes the limitation.

claims.text: Concurrency cap SPECIFICALLY for gate_concurrent_writes, independent of max_workers. Deliberately conservative and separately configurable.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain gate_concurrent_writes or evidence that this cap is enforced separately; the claim references code outside this chunk.

claims.text: every concurrent write-mode offload() triggers a FULL structcore re-index (offload.py's post-write blast-radius fence, cached_index(..., refresh=True)), and that cache's single-flight lock is keyed by RESOLVED ROOT (structcore/index.py::cached_index) -- so N worktrees, N distinct roots, N UNSHARED full re-index builds competing for CPU/RAM at once. NOT MEASURED on this box for N>1 -- the default stays low until someone measures the real cost and raises it deliberately.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain offload(), cached_index, or any code that implements or confirms this behavior; references are to external files.

claims.text: Extra pool workers Ikarus can spin up for fan-out beyond the role shadows.
claims.why: The comment describes _bench as an extra pool; the code initializes _bench as a cycle of ollama roster, which aligns with the comment.

claims.text: Clear each task. Only low-risk work that Adam would offload is taken; anything that routes back to Claude is bounced to Adam.
claims.why: The chunk only contains the method signature; the implementation is not present to verify the described behavior.

claims.text: repo_root makes the target repo's own .agentenv/agents/ roster visible to routing (without it only global agents route).
claims.why: The chunk does not contain the implementation of accept or any routing logic that uses repo_root.

observations.what: Module docstring describes high-level architecture but no code in this chunk implements it.
_paths_overlap is defined but not called in this chunk; may be dead code or used later.
Imports of load_project and load_policy are inside __post_init__; this could cause late import errors or circular imports.
max_parallel_writes default is 2 but comment warns about unmeasured cost for N>1; risk of performance degradation if used concurrently.
active_agents is parsed from team.get('active_agents') but the field is never used in this chunk.
